scope: Synthetic actual UI save/reopen/export task, not full Release gate

ui_observations.move_history: 4 states, Undo 2, Redo 0, only one pixel-move history addition
ui_observations.undo_then_save: 3 states, Undo 1, Redo 1; selected layer equals original source RGBA
ui_observations.redo_then_save: Full project SHA256 restored to first saved move
ui_observations.save_as_identity: Window title changed to save-as project
ui_observations.actual_reopen: Native file panel opened copy; history titles retained, open-project appended, Undo/Redo stacks reset
ui_observations.exit: App quit normally without unsaved-project prompt

limitations: No displayed frame latency or GUI-memory claim
Historical titles are not persisted Undo snapshots
